GameConditionDef.label: nephilitic fog
GameConditionDef.description: Nephilitic fog reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons and can sicken humanoid pawns that spend too much time outside in it.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a cloud of nephila nanites will blanket the area around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration], infesting those who walk outside and slowly driving them to go berserk with lust.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The nephilitic nanite fog has passed on.
GameConditionDef.letterText: It starts with a strange wind, kicking up white dust from some distant land. The dust sticks to the lungs and fills the air with a faint, sickly sweet smell. As the dust storm becomes intense enough to make it difficult to see, a large, snakelike creature emerges. It's abdomen is bulbous and swollen and it's clear that it is soon to give birth. Deal with it swiftly or prepare for the worst.
